_note: Register fragment for publication-detail-for-the-portal (REQ-PDP-001). The publication carries attachmentOrder, the file ids of its documents in the order an officer set; PublicationService::attachments() answers the public and federation attachment lists in that order. Named to merge after woo-information-categories-as-data.json, so its version wins. It also adds errorReport (REQ-PDP-005): a report a visitor posts on a publication of a catalogue that accepts them. Reports have no public read rule and are never published; the moderator groups the catalogue names get a notification, and only members of those groups (and admins) read and update them, and only admins change which publication, catalogue, moment and groups a report belongs to.

attachmentOrder.title: Attachment order
attachmentOrder.description: The file ids of the publication's documents in the order the portal shows them. Files not listed follow by upload time.

errorReport.title: Error report
errorReport.summary: An error a visitor reported in a publication
errorReport.description: A visitor's report of an error in a publication. It is taken only for a catalogue that accepts error reports and names a moderator group. The report stores no IP address of the sender and is never published.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication the report is about.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.description: The catalogue the publication was read through.

message.title: Message
message.description: What the visitor reported, at most 2,000 characters.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: An address to answer the visitor, when they gave one.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the moderators are with the report.

moderators.title: Moderator groups
moderators.description: The catalogue's moderator groups when the report came in. The notification goes to their members.

subject.en: New error report on a publication

errorReport.comment: Never read by an anonymous reader; written only by the public error report route
